column3: A huge armoured man stands with a shield on his left arm, then lifts a long heavy hammer high over his right shoulder, rears back, and slams it down hard in front of him in one massive overhead blow, bending his knees with the impact, then holds perfectly still.
A huge armoured man spins on the spot swinging a long heavy hammer in big fast circles over his head with his right arm fully extended, leaning into the spin, three full turns, then slows and stops.
A huge armoured man braces a shield on his left arm, then lunges forward and slams the shield into an enemy with his whole body weight, shoulders driving forward, then recovers to a steady stance.
A huge heavy armoured man stands braced, is hit hard in the chest, reels backwards with his arms flung out, falls heavily onto his back, one leg twitches, and lies still.
A huge armoured man plants a long heavy hammer on the ground, then pounds his chest with his free fist twice, throws his head back with a roar, then raises the hammer overhead in triumph and holds.
A huge armoured man is struck in the chest, his upper body jerks back, he rocks onto his back foot with a grunt, then recovers his stance.
A slender woman stands holding a bow, is hit in the back, stumbles forward two steps, drops to her knees, drops the bow, and collapses face down and lies still.
A slender woman holding a bow in her left hand spins once on her toes, raises the bow high overhead with a triumphant smile and a little hop, then holds the pose.
A slender woman holding a bow is hit from the side, flinches and twists away with her shoulders, steps back and recovers her ready stance.
A slender woman holding a bow in her left hand draws an arrow back to her cheek with her right hand, aims steadily, releases, follows through with the bow arm, and holds.
A slender woman holding a bow springs sideways in a quick sidestep roll to the left, comes up on one knee and rises into a ready stance.
A huge armoured man stands, throws his arms wide and roars at the sky, stamps one foot heavily, and slams his fist against his chest, then holds.
